The group $\widetilde{G}_{\mathbf{k}}$ considered here should not be confused with the group $\tilde{G}$ of §3.3.

9.1 First step: $\widetilde{G}_{\mathbf{k}}$ is a split connected reductive algebraic group over $\mathbf{k}$
card.label: Remark 9.1

paper.title: Notes on the geometric Satake equivalence
paper.abstract: These notes are devoted to a detailed exposition of the proof of the Geometric Satake Equivalence for general coefficients, following Mirkovic-Vilonen.
